units.literal: Now you, sir, have had the fortune to roam in an age of emperors and kings, personally to wear the cap-strings and robes of office, to float amid brilliance and steep yourself in the Way and virtue, to gaze long on the patterns of dragon and tiger—this has gone on long.

units.zh: 卒不能攄首尾，奮翼鱗，振拔洿塗，跨騰風雲，使見之者景駭，聞之者嚮震。
units.en: Yet you never spread wings from the mud or ride the tempest so that sight of you would stagger the world.
units.literal: Yet in the end you cannot spread head and tail, flap scales and fins, struggle free of the mire, leap through wind and cloud, so that those who see you stand awestruck and those who hear you turn in admiration.

units.zh: 徒樂枕經籍書，紆體衡門，上無所蔕，下無所根。
units.en: You hug your books beneath a humble gate, tethered neither to high office nor to solid ground.
units.literal: You merely delight in pillowing your head on the classics and histories, folding your limbs within a plain gate, with nothing above to cling to and nothing below to root you.

units.zh: 獨攄意虖宇宙之外，銳思於豪芒之內，潛神默記，恆以年歲。
units.en: You send the mind past the sky while polishing thoughts on a pinpoint, brooding in silence year on year.
units.literal: Alone you let your thoughts wander beyond the cosmos and hone them finer than a hair's tip; you sink your spirit in silent memorization year after year.

units.zh: 然而器不賈於當己，用不效於一世， 雖馳辯如濤波，摛藻如春華，猶無益於殿最。
units.en: Still your talent finds no buyer today, your use no proof in this life; torrents of eloquence and springtime rhetoric win you no place in the merit roll.
units.literal: Yet your vessel is not priced in the market of the moment, your use is not tested in a single generation; though your disputation surges like breakers and your phrases unfold like spring blossoms, it still does no good in the ranking of first and last.

units.zh: 意者，且運朝夕之策，定合會之計，使存有顯號，亡有美諡，不亦優虖？」
units.en: Why not scheme for office and alliance so the living gain rank and the dead fine posthumous names—would that not be wiser?"
units.literal: Perhaps you should instead ply morning-and-evening stratagems, fix plans for alliance and conference, so that the living win glorious titles and the dead fair posthumous names—would that not be better?"

units.zh: 主人逌爾而咲曰：「若賓之言，斯所謂見勢利之華，闇道德之實，守穾奧之熒燭，未卬天庭而睹白日也。
units.en: The host smiled faintly and said, "What you say is what people call seeing the blossoms of power and profit while remaining blind to the substance of the Way and virtue, guarding a flickering candle in a hidden corner without ever lifting your eyes to the heavenly court to behold the bright sun.
units.literal: The host smiled faintly and said, "If that is your doctrine, it is what people call seeing the flowers of power and profit while blind to the fruit of the Way, guarding a guttering candle in a corner and never lifting your eyes to the celestial court to behold the bright sun.

units.zh: 曩者王塗蕪穢，周失其御，侯伯方軌，戰國橫騖，於是七雄虓闞，分裂諸夏，龍戰而虎爭。
units.en: Once royal roads rotted, Zhou lost control, barons raced abreast, and the seven powers tore China in a war of dragon and tiger.
units.literal: Formerly the royal highways were choked with weeds, Zhou lost the reins, marquises ran on parallel tracks, the Warring States raced crosswise; then the seven champions roared and wrestled, split the central states, and dragon fought with tiger.

units.zh: 游說之徒，風颺電激，並起而救之，其餘猋飛景附，煜霅其間者，蓋不可勝載。
units.en: Rhetoricians stormed in like wind and lightning, and hangers-on swarmed beyond counting.
units.literal: Wandering persuaders, swift as wind and lightning, rose together to rescue the age; the rest, like gales and flying shadows attaching themselves, flashed among them in numbers no carriage could carry.

units.zh: 當此之時，搦朽摩鈍，鈆刀皆能壹斷，是故魯連飛一矢而蹶千金，虞卿以顧眄而捐相印也。
units.en: In that chaos a blunt knife could decide a fate, so Lu Zhonglian felled a fortune with one shaft and Yu Qing dropped a premier's seal at a glance.
units.literal: In such a time, even a rotten twig or a dull blade could cut clean at one stroke; therefore Lu Zhonglian loosed a single arrow and toppled a thousand pounds of gold, and Yu Qing, with a glance, cast away the minister's seal.

units.zh: 夫啾發投曲，感耳之聲，合之律度，淫䵷而不可聽者，非韶、夏之樂也；
units.en: Shrill novelty may please the ear yet fail the scale—that is not the music of Shao and Xia;
units.literal: For twittering runs and tossed-off tunes that please the ear yet, set beside pitch and measure, prove lewd and unfit to hear—that is not the music of Shao and Xia;

units.zh: 因勢合變，偶時之會，風移俗易，乖忤而不可通者，非君子之法也。
units.en: and tactics that chase fashion until custom warps are not the gentleman's law.
units.literal: for opportunism that rides the moment, suits passing fashion, shifts custom, and ends in perverse blockage—that is not the gentleman's law.

units.zh: 及至從人合之，衡人散之，亡命漂說，羇旅騁辭，商鞅挾三術以鑽孝公，李斯奮時務而要始皇，彼皆躡風雲之會，履顛沛之勢，據徼乘邪以求一日之富貴，朝為榮華，夕而焦瘁，福不盈眥，禍益於世，凶人且以自悔，況吉士而是賴虖！
units.en: Think of the vertical and horizontal strategists and the exiles who peddled their arguments: Shang Yang used three techniques to insinuate himself with Duke Xiao, and Li Si exploited the needs of the age to win over the First Emperor. They caught the winds of opportunity and rode the turmoil of their times, seizing crooked chances to gain a day's wealth and honor. Glorious in the morning, by evening they were ruined; their good fortune did not last a moment, while their calamities burdened the age. Even evil men came to regret this path. How much less should a good man rely on it?
units.literal: When the vertical persuaders united men and the horizontal persuaders divided them, fugitives wandered about arguing and travelers displayed their rhetoric. Shang Yang carried three techniques to insinuate himself with Duke Xiao, while Li Si exerted himself in the urgent affairs of the age and won over the First Emperor. They all stepped into a conjunction of wind and cloud, trod a situation of upheaval, relied on narrow chances, and rode crooked paths in pursuit of a day's wealth and honor. In the morning they flourished; by evening they were withered. Their good fortune did not last the blink of an eye, while their calamities burdened the age. Even wicked men came to regret this; how much less should a good man rely on it!

units.zh: 且功不可以虛成，名不可以偽立，韓設辯以徼君，呂行詐以賈國。
units.en: Merit cannot be faked nor name bought: Han Fei angled his prince with rhetoric, Lü Buwei sold the realm by deceit.
units.literal: Moreover merit cannot be hollowly achieved, nor name falsely erected: Han Fei set sophistry to hook his ruler, Lü Buwei practiced fraud to traffic in the state.

units.zh: 說難既酋，其身乃囚；
units.en: Han Fei completed "The Difficulty of Persuasion," only to be imprisoned;
units.literal: When the "Difficulty of Persuasion" was finished, his person was imprisoned;

units.zh: 秦貨既貴，厥宗亦隧。
units.en: once Lü Buwei's Qin merchandise had fetched its high price, his clan too sank into the grave.
units.literal: when Qin's bribe had grown costly, his clan too went down the tunnel.

units.zh: 是故仲尼抗浮雲之志，孟軻養浩然之氣，彼豈樂為迂闊哉？
units.en: So Confucius fixed his mind above the clouds and Mencius fed the flood-like breath—were they merely eccentric?
units.literal: Therefore Zhongni set his will above drifting clouds, and Meng Ke nurtured the flood-like qi—did they delight in being impractical?

units.zh: 道不可以貳也。
units.en: The Way allows no divided loyalty.
units.literal: The Way does not admit doubleness.

units.zh: 方今大漢洒埽群穢，夷險芟荒，廓帝紘，恢皇綱，基隆於羲、農，規廣於黃、唐；
units.en: Great Han has cleansed the mire, cut the brambles, stretched the emperor's net wider than Fu Xi or Shen Nong, vaster than Huangdi or Yao;
units.literal: Now the great Han has swept away every stain, leveled peril, mowed the wilds, spread the imperial cord, widened the royal net; its foundation rises higher than Xi and Nong, its compass vaster than Huang and Tang;

units.zh: 其君天下也，炎之如日，威之如神，函之如海，養之如春。
units.en: its rule warms like the sun, awes like a god, holds all like the sea, and quickens like spring.
units.literal: in ruling all under Heaven it blazes like the sun, awes like a spirit, embraces like the sea, nurtures like spring.

units.zh: 是以六合之內，莫不同原共流，沐浴玄德，稟卬太和，枝附葉著，譬猶屮木之殖山林，鳥魚之毓川澤，得氣者蕃滋，失時者苓落，參天墬而施化，豈云人事之厚薄哉？
units.en: Within the six directions all drink one stream, bathe in hidden virtue, and cling like leaves to a tree; timing makes the growth, heaven and earth do the shaping—human whim weighs little.
units.literal: Therefore within the six coordinates none fail to share one source and one current, bathe in dark virtue, drink deep of supreme harmony, cling like branches and leaves; they are like plants growing in mountain forests, birds and fish breeding in rivers and marshes—those who catch the vapor flourish and multiply, those who miss the season wither and fall; Heaven and earth join to spread transformation—how can one speak of human affairs being thick or thin?

units.zh: 今子處皇世而論戰國，耀所聞而疑所覿，欲從旄敦而度高虖泰山，懷氿濫而測深虖重淵，亦未至也。」
units.en: Now you, sir, live in a glorious age yet discourse on the Warring States, dazzled by hearsay while doubting what you see. You would use a low mound to gauge Mount Tai and a puddle to fathom the abyss. You are nowhere near the mark."
units.literal: Now you, sir, stand in a brilliant age yet discourse on the Warring States, dazzle yourself with hearsay and doubt what your eyes see; you would measure Mount Tai with a yardstick from Dunhuang or fathom the abyss with a puddle from a marsh—you have not reached the mark."

units.zh: 賓曰：「若夫鞅、斯之倫，衰周之凶人，既聞命矣。
units.en: The guest said, "As for men like Shang Yang and Li Si, villains of failing Zhou—I have heard your command.
units.literal: The guest said, "As for men like Shang Yang and Li Si, villains of failing Zhou—I have heard your command.

units.zh: 敢問上古之士，處身行道，輔世成名，可述於後者，默而已虖？」
units.en: But did the ancients who kept the Way, aided their times, and left great names do it in silence?"
units.literal: May I ask: among men of high antiquity who kept their persons, practiced the Way, aided the age, and won names handed down—did they stay silent?"

units.zh: 主人曰：「何為其然也！
units.en: The host answered, "Why imagine such a thing?
units.literal: The host said, "Why should it be so?

units.zh: 昔咎繇謨虞，箕子訪周，言通帝王，謀合聖神；
units.en: Gao Yao advised Shun, Jizi counseled Zhou—their speech reached kings, their plans matched the spirits;
units.literal: Formerly Gao Yao counseled Shun, Jizi was questioned in Zhou—their words penetrated emperors and kings, their plans matched sages and spirits;

units.zh: 殷說夢發於傅巖，周望兆動於渭濱，齊甯激聲於康衢，漢良受書於邳沂，皆俟命而神交，匪詞言之所信，故能建必然之策，展無窮之勳也。
units.en: Fu Yue was revealed in a dream at Fuyan; Lü Wang's omen stirred on the banks of the Wei; Ning Qi's song rang out at the crossroads; and Zhang Liang received the book at the bridge at Xiapi. All awaited their appointed time and communed in spirit, relying on more than words; thus they could devise certain strategies and achieve immeasurable merit.
units.literal: The dream of Yin's Fu Yue arose at Fuyan; the omen of Zhou's Lü Wang stirred on the bank of the Wei; Qi's Ning Qi raised his voice at the broad crossroads; and Han's Zhang Liang received the book at the bridge at Xiapi. All awaited their appointed time and met in spirit, not through trust in spoken words; therefore they could establish certain strategies and unfold inexhaustible merit.

units.zh: 近者陸子優繇，新語以興；
units.en: Lu Jia, calm and unhurried, raised the New Discourses;
units.literal: In recent times Master Lu, leisurely and easy, raised the New Discourses to prominence;

units.zh: 董生下帷，發藻儒林；
units.en: Dong Zhongshu drew his curtain and lit the grove of scholars;
units.literal: Dong Zhongshu let down his curtain and sent brilliance through the Confucian grove;

units.zh: 劉向司籍，辯章舊聞；
units.en: Liu Xiang ordered the archives and clarified antiquity;
units.literal: Liu Xiang superintended the registers and sorted the old hearsay;

units.zh: 揚雄覃思，法言、大玄：皆及時君之門闈，究先聖之壼奧，婆娑虖術藝之場，休息虖篇籍之囿，以全其質而發其文，用納虖聖聽，列炳於後人，斯非其亞與！
units.en: Yang Xiong brooded out the Model Sayings and Great Arcana; each entered the ruler's gate, sounded the sages' chambers, ranged the field of learning, and left texts that shine for posterity—second only to the greatest.
units.literal: Yang Xiong pondered deeply and produced the Model Sayings and the Great Mystery: all reached the inner gates of the timely ruler, fathomed the inner rooms of former sages, wandered in the arena of arts, rested in the park of writings, thereby preserving their substance and releasing their pattern, were taken into the sage's hearing, and blaze in rows for later men—are these not next after the highest?

units.zh: 若乃夷抗行於首陽，惠降志於辱仕，顏耽樂於簞瓢，孔終篇於西狩，聲盈塞於天淵，真吾徒之師表也。
units.en: Then there were Boyi, who upheld his conduct on Mount Shouyang; Liuxia Hui, who humbled his aspirations to take a dishonorable post; Yan Hui, who delighted in his basket of rice and gourd of water; and Confucius, who brought his classic to an end with the hunt in the west. Their fame fills the space between heaven and the abyss; they are truly exemplars for men such as us.
units.literal: Or again, Boyi upheld his conduct on Shouyang; Liuxia Hui lowered his aspirations to accept a humiliating post; Yan Hui delighted in a basket of rice and a gourd of water; and Confucius ended his classic with the western hunt. Their fame fills the space between heaven and the abyss; they are true models for men such as us.

units.zh: 且吾聞之：壹陰壹陽，天墬之方；
units.en: I have heard that yin and yang are the square of heaven and earth;
units.literal: Moreover I have heard: one yin, one yang—this is Heaven and earth's square;

units.zh: 乃文乃質，王道之綱；
units.en: culture and substance are the twin cords of the kingly Way;
units.literal: both pattern and substance—this is the kingly Way's cord;

units.zh: 有同有異，聖喆之常。
units.en: sameness and difference are the sage's constant scales.
units.literal: having sameness and having difference—this is the constant of the wise and good.

units.zh: 故曰：慎修所志，守爾天符，委命共己，味道之腴，神之聽之，名其舍諸！
units.en: The ode says: polish your purpose, keep Heaven's tally, yield life to what is already yours, taste the Way's fat—when spirits listen, can fame stay away?
units.literal: Therefore it is said: carefully cultivate what you aim at, guard your Heaven-given tally, entrust life to what is already in yourself, taste the richness of the Way; when the spirits listen, will fame leave you?

units.zh: 賓又不聞龢氏之璧韞於荊石，隨侯之珠藏於蜯蛤虖？
units.en: Have you never heard how the He-bi jade slept inside a dull rock or Sui's pearl hid in a shell?
units.literal: Again, have you not heard that the He clan jade was wrapped in a Jing stone, or that the Marquis of Sui's pearl lay hidden in a mussel?

units.zh: 歷世莫眡，不知其將含景耀，吐英精，曠千載而流夜光也。
units.en: Ages passed before anyone knew they would blaze with inner fire and gleam in the dark after a thousand years.
units.literal: Age after age none saw them, not knowing they would hold radiant light and spit essence, idle a thousand years yet shed light by night.

units.zh: 應龍潛於潢汙，魚黿媟之，不睹其能奮靈德，合風雲，超忽荒，而躆顥蒼也。
units.en: The winged dragon wallowed in a puddle while minnows mocked him, blind to the day he would ride the storm into the blue.
units.literal: The responding dragon lurked in a muddy pool; fish and turtles despised him, not seeing how he could rouse numinous virtue, join wind and cloud, leap beyond the vast waste, and stand in the azure sky.

units.zh: 故夫泥蟠而天飛者，應龍之神也；
units.en: Mud-bound yet sky-soaring—that is the responding dragon;
units.literal: Therefore one who coils in the mud yet flies to Heaven is the spirit of the responding dragon;

units.zh: 先賤而後貴者，龢、隨之珍也；
units.en: cheap at first, costly later—that is the He jade and Sui pearl;
units.literal: one who is base first and honored later is the treasure of He and Sui;

units.zh: 時闇而久章者，君子之真也。
units.en: long hidden, long bright—that is the gentleman's truth.
units.literal: one who is dim for a time yet shines long is the truth of the gentleman.

units.zh: 若乃牙、曠清耳於管絃，離婁眇目於豪分；
units.en: When Ya and Kuang tune their ears to music, or Li Lou splits a hair's breadth;
units.literal: If then Ya and Kuang clear their ears to strings and pipes, and Li Lou strains his eyes to a hair's fraction;

units.zh: 逢蒙絕技於弧矢，班輸榷巧於斧斤；
units.en: when Peng Meng masters the bow or Lu Ban the adze;
units.literal: Peng Meng exhausts his skill on bow and arrow, Lu Ban measures his craft on axe and adze;

units.zh: 良樂軼能於相馭，烏獲抗力於千鈞；
units.en: when Wang Liang and Bo Le judge horses or Wu Huo hefts a thousand jun;
units.literal: Wang Liang and Bo Le surpass others in judging and driving, Wu Huo matches strength against a thousand jun;

units.zh: 龢、鵲發精於鍼石，研、桑心計於無垠。
units.en: Yi He and Bian Que mastered the needle and stone probe; Ji Yan and Sang Hongyang's financial calculations knew no bounds.
units.literal: Yi He and Bian Que brought their finest skill to needles and stone probes; Ji Yan and Sang Hongyang applied mental calculation without limit.

units.zh: 僕亦不任廁技於彼列，故密爾自娛於斯文。」
units.en: I am not fit to stack my small talent beside theirs, so I take quiet joy in these words alone."
units.literal: I, your servant, am not fit to crowd my petty skill among them; therefore I quietly take my pleasure in this writing."

units.zh: 及秦孝公用商君，壞井田，開仟伯，急耕戰之賞，雖非古道，猶以務本之故，傾鄰國而雄諸侯。
units.en: When Duke Xiao of Qin employed Lord Shang, Shang Yang abolished the well-field system, opened the field boundaries, and offered urgent rewards for farming and war. Though these measures departed from ancient ways, their focus on fundamentals enabled Qin to overwhelm its neighbors and dominate the other lords.
units.literal: When Duke Xiao of Qin used Lord Shang, he broke well-fields, opened boundaries, and hastened rewards for farming and war. Though not the ancient way, by attending to fundamentals he overwhelmed neighboring states and dominated lords.

units.zh: 今將軍以藩戚之重，東南之眾，盡忠奉上，戮力勤王，豈不勳高竇融，寵過吳芮，析珪判野，南面稱孤？
units.en: Now you, with a frontier kinsman's weight and the southeast's masses, exhaust loyalty serving above and join strength in diligent service to the king—is not merit higher than Dou Rong's, favor passing Wu Rui's, splitting jade tallies and judging fields, facing south and calling yourself solitary?
units.literal: Now the general, with the weight of a frontier kinsman and the masses of the southeast, exhausts loyalty in serving above and joins strength in diligent service to the king—is not merit higher than Dou Rong's, favor passing Wu Rui's, splitting jade tallies and judging fields, facing south and calling himself solitary?

units.zh: 沈炯 虞荔 弟寄 馬樞
units.en: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu
units.literal: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu

units.zh: 時穆子容為巡省使，嘆曰：「古人有言：『聞伯夷之風，貪夫廉，懦夫有立。』
units.en: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said, "The ancients said: 'Hear the wind of Bo Yi, and the greedy grow honest; the timid stand firm.'
units.literal: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said: "The ancients had a saying: 'When one hears the wind of Bo Yi, the greedy grow honest and the timid stand firm.'

units.zh: 李渾 子湛 渾弟繪 族子公緒 李璵 弟瑾 族弟曉 鄭述祖 子元德
units.en: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande
units.literal: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande

units.zh: 與梁人泛言氏族，袁狎曰：「未若我本出自黃帝，姓在十四之限。」
units.en: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said, "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."
units.literal: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said: "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."

units.zh: 建始以來，王氏始執國命，哀、平短祚，莽遂篡位，蓋其威福所由來者漸矣！
units.en: Since Jianshi, the Wang clan began to grasp the state's fate. Ai and Ping had short reigns, Mang then usurped the throne—indeed the source of his power and fortune was gradual!
units.literal: Jianshi since, Wang clan began grasped state fate, Ai, Ping short blessings, Mang then usurped position, cover his power blessing what from came gradually indeed!

units.zh: 客難東方朔曰：「蘇秦、張儀一當萬乘之主，而都卿相之位，澤及後世。
units.en: The guest reproached Dongfang Shuo: "Su Qin and Zhang Yi each won an audience with a great king and walked away as chief minister; their good fortune lasted for generations.
units.literal: A guest rebuked Dongfang Shuo, saying: "Su Qin and Zhang Yi, each in one encounter with a ruler of ten thousand chariots, then occupied minister and chancellor positions, and their bounty reached later generations.

units.zh: 十一月，項羽殺宋義，并其兵渡河，自立為上將軍，諸將黥布等皆屬。
units.en: In the eleventh month, Xiang Yu killed Song Yi and took his troops, crossed the river, and established himself as supreme commander. Generals like Ying Bu and others all came under his command.
units.literal: Eleventh month, Xiang Yu killed Song Yi, merged his troops crossed the river, self-established as supreme general, various generals Ying Bu and others all belonged to him.

units.zh: 聞沛公已定關中，羽大怒，使黥布等攻破函谷關，遂至戲下。
units.en: When he heard that Pei Gong had already pacified Guanzhong, Xiang Yu was furious and sent Ying Bu and others to break through Hangu Pass, then advanced to Xi.
units.literal: He heard that Pei Gong had already pacified Guanzhong. Xiang Yu was greatly angered and sent Ying Bu and others to break through Hangu Pass, then reached Xixia.

units.zh: 漢王西過梁地，至虞，謂謁者隨何曰：「公能說九江王布使舉兵畔楚，項王必留擊之。
units.en: The King of Han passed west through Liang territory and reached Yu. He said to the usher Sui He: "Can you persuade Ying Bu, King of Jiujiang, to raise troops and rebel against Chu? Xiang Yu will certainly stay behind to attack him.
units.literal: King Han passed west through Liang territory and reached Yu. He said to the usher Sui He: "You can persuade King Jiujiang Ying Bu to raise troops and rebel against Chu. Xiang Yu will certainly stay to attack him.

units.zh: 隨何往說布，果使畔楚。
units.en: Sui He went to persuade Ying Bu, and indeed made him rebel against Chu.
units.literal: Sui He went to persuade Ying Bu, and indeed made him rebel against Chu.

units.zh: 隨何既說黥布，布起兵攻楚。
units.en: After Sui He persuaded Ying Bu, Bu raised troops to attack Chu.
units.literal: After Sui He persuaded Ying Bu, Bu raised troops to attack Chu.

units.zh: 楚使項聲、龍且攻布，布戰不勝。
units.en: Chu sent Xiang Sheng and Long Ju to attack Bu. Bu fought but was not victorious.
units.literal: Chu sent Xiang Sheng and Long Ju to attack Bu. Bu fought but was not victorious.

units.zh: 十二月，布與隨何間行歸漢。
units.en: In the twelfth month, Bu and Sui He secretly made their way back to Han.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Bu and Sui He secretly made their way back to Han.

units.zh: 漢王從其計，出軍宛葉間，與黥布行收兵。
units.en: King Han followed his plan, led troops out between Wan and Ye, and together with Ying Bu went to gather troops.
units.literal: King Han followed his plan, led troops out between Wan and Ye, and together with Ying Bu went to gather troops.

units.zh: 秋七月，立黥布為淮南王。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, he established Ying Bu as King of Huainan.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, he established Ying Bu as King of Huainan.

units.zh: 當陽君英布為九江王，都六。
units.en: Dangyang Lord Ying Bu as King of Jiujiang, capital at Liu.
units.literal: Dangyang Lord Ying Bu as King of Jiujiang, capital at Liu.

units.zh: 二年冬十月，項羽使九江王布殺義帝於郴。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter in the second year, Xiang Yu ordered King Jiujiang Ying Bu to kill Righteous Emperor Huai at Chen.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter in the second year, Xiang Yu ordered King Jiujiang Ying Bu to kill Righteous Emperor Huai at Chen.

units.zh: 先是，谷永以為「河，中國之經瀆，聖王興則出圖書，王道廢則竭絕。
units.en: Earlier, Gu Yong had argued: "The Yellow River is the great central channel of China. Under sage rule, auspicious charts appear; when the kingly way declines, waterways fail.
units.literal: Before this, Gu Yong held: "The River is the central channel of the Middle Kingdom. When sage kings arise, diagrams and writings emerge; when kingly way declines, channels dry and break.

units.zh: 今潰溢橫流，漂沒陵阜，異之大者也。
units.en: Now it bursts and runs wild, drowning even ridges and mounds. This is an extreme portent.
units.literal: Now breaches and lateral flows wash over and submerge mounds and high grounds. This is a great anomaly.

units.zh: 修政以應之，災變自除。」
units.en: Reform government in response, and these disasters and portents will fade of themselves."
units.literal: Rectify governance to respond; the disasters and omens will remove themselves."

units.zh: 又嘗令左右誦漢書，臥而聽之，至蒯通說韓信曰「相君之背，貴不可言」，寶應蹶然起曰「可謂智士」。
units.en: He once had his attendants read the Book of Han aloud while he listened from his couch. When they reached Kuai Tong's advice to Han Xin—"If you turn your back on Han, your rank will be beyond words"—Baoying sprang up and exclaimed, "A truly wise man!"
units.literal: He once had his attendants recite the Book of Han while he listened lying down. When they came to Kuai Tong telling Han Xin, "When I read your back, your nobility is beyond words," Baoying sprang up and said, "He can truly be called a wise man."

units.zh: 寄正色曰：「覆酈驕韓，未足稱智；
units.en: Ji answered sternly: "A man whose schemes destroyed Li Yiji and filled Han Xin with arrogance hardly deserves to be called wise.
units.literal: Ji said sternly: "Bringing ruin upon Li Yiji and making Han Xin arrogant is not enough to be called wisdom;

units.zh: 觀其誠信感物，雖李將軍之恂恂善誘，殆無以加焉。
units.en: To see how his honesty moved men—even General Li Guang's gentle way with troops could hardly match it.
units.literal: Seeing how his sincerity and faith moved things—even General Li's gentle, persuasive manner can scarcely add to this.

units.zh: 尚書敬顯儁曰：「孔子云：『微管仲，吾其被發左衽矣』以此言之，右衽為是。」
units.en: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
units.literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

units.zh: 董仲舒說上曰：「春秋它穀不書，至於麥禾不成則書之，以此見聖人於五穀最重麥與禾也。
units.en: Dong Zhongshu said to the emperor, 'In the Spring and Autumn Annals other grains are not recorded, but when wheat and millet fail to ripen it is recorded—showing that the sage gave greatest weight among the five grains to wheat and millet.
units.literal: Dong Zhongshu advised the emperor: 'In Spring and Autumn, other grains are not recorded, but when wheat and millet fail it is recorded-showing sages gave greatest weight among grains to wheat and millet.

units.zh: 仲舒死後，功費愈甚，天下虛耗，人復相食。
units.en: After his death, fiscal overextension intensified and extreme famine reappeared.
units.literal: After Zhongshu's death, expenditures and projects grew still greater; the realm emptied and consumed, people again ate one another.

units.zh: 武帝末年，悔征伐之事，乃封丞相為富民侯。
units.en: Late in Emperor Wu's reign, he regretted the campaigns and then enfeoffed the Chancellor as Marquis of Enriching the People.
units.literal: At Emperor Wu's late years, he regretted campaigns and then enfeoffed the Chancellor as Marquis of Enriching the People.

units.zh: 今關中俗不好種麥，是歲失春秋之所重，而損生民之具也。
units.en: Now the Guanzhong region dislikes planting wheat, and each year it neglects what the Annals values most, diminishing the people's means of livelihood.
units.literal: Now Guanzhong customs do not like sowing wheat, so each year they lose what Spring and Autumn values and damage the means of people's life.

units.zh: 願陛下幸詔大司農，使關中民益種宿麥，令毋後時。」
units.en: May Your Majesty command the Grand Minister of Agriculture to have the people of Guanzhong plant more winter wheat and not miss the season.'
units.literal: May Your Majesty command the Grand Minister of Agriculture that Guanzhong people increase winter wheat and not miss seasonal timing.'

units.zh: 又言：「古者稅民不過什一，其求易共；
units.en: He also said: 'In antiquity taxing people was no more than one-tenth, easy to provide;
units.literal: He also said: 'In antiquity taxing people was no more than one-tenth, easy to provide;

units.zh: 使民不過三日，其力易足。
units.en: and labor demands were limited enough to preserve household capacity.
units.literal: using people's labor no more than three days, their strength easy to suffice.

units.zh: 民財內足以養老盡孝，外足以事上共稅，下足以畜妻子極愛，故民說從上。
units.en: When household subsistence and obligations were simultaneously manageable, political obedience was voluntary.
units.literal: People's means were enough internally to care for elders and fulfill filiality, externally to serve superiors and taxes, below to support wives and children with full love, thus people gladly followed superiors.

units.zh: 至秦則不然，用商鞅之法，改帝王之制，除井田，民得賣買，富者田連仟伯，貧者亡立錐之地。
units.en: Qin reforms enabled severe land concentration and peasant landlessness.
units.literal: By Qin, not so: using Shang Yang's law, changing imperial kings' institutions, removing well-fields and allowing sale-purchase, rich fields stretched by tens and hundreds while poor had no ground to stand an awl.

units.zh: 又顓川澤之利，管山林之饒，荒淫越制，踰侈以相高；
units.en: State and elite control over resource rents fueled escalating luxury and inequality.
units.literal: It monopolized river-marsh profits and managed mountain-forest riches; wild excess surpassed norms, competing in extravagance.

units.zh: 邑有人君之尊，里有公侯之富，小民安得不困？
units.en: Sub-state elite power became so great that ordinary households had little room to survive.
units.literal: In towns there was lordly dignity, in villages marquis-level wealth-how could small people not be trapped?

units.zh: 又加月為更卒，已復為正，一歲屯戍，一歲力役，三十倍於古；
units.en: Labor conscription expanded to levels far above classical precedent.
units.literal: Further, adding monthly service as garrison labor and regular labor in sequence-one year frontier garrison, one year corvée-threefold ten times antiquity.

units.zh: 田租口賦，鹽鐵之利，二十倍於古。
units.en: The combined tax burden became vastly heavier than classical norms.
units.literal: Field rent and head tax, plus salt and iron revenues, were twenty times antiquity.

units.zh: 或耕豪民之田，見稅什五。
units.en: Tenancy under great households imposed predatory effective rates.
units.literal: Some tilled powerful households' fields and were taxed at five parts in ten.

units.zh: 故貧民常衣牛馬之衣，而食犬彘之食。
units.en: Peasant living standards degraded to near-animal subsistence.
units.literal: Thus poor people often wore ox-and-horse clothing and ate dog-and-pig food.

units.zh: 重以貪暴之吏，刑戮妄加，民愁亡聊，亡逃山林，轉為盜賊，赭衣半道，斷獄歲以千萬數。
units.en: Administrative violence plus poverty drove flight, crime, and mass penalization.
units.literal: Added to this were greedy violent officials with arbitrary executions, people grieving without livelihood, fleeing into hills and forests turning to banditry, red convict clothes half the roads, and yearly prison judgments in tens of millions.

units.zh: 漢興，循而未改。
units.en: Early Han inherited much of this structure before reform.
units.literal: When Han arose, it followed this and had not changed.

units.zh: 古井田法雖難卒行，宜少近古，限民名田，以澹不足，塞并兼之路。
units.en: Full restoration may be impossible, but partial anti-concentration land limits were urged.
units.literal: Though the old well-field law is hard to suddenly enact, one should somewhat approach antiquity: limit titled land holdings to relieve insufficiency and block annexation paths.

units.zh: 鹽鐵皆歸於民。
units.en: He advocated devolving salt and iron profits away from monopolistic control.
units.literal: Salt and iron should all return to the people.

units.zh: 去奴婢，除專殺之威。
units.en: He also called for reducing coercive private domination.
units.literal: Remove slave categories and eliminate power of arbitrary killing.

units.zh: 薄賦斂，省繇役，以寬民力。
units.en: Tax and labor burdens should be reduced to restore social stamina.
units.literal: Lighten taxes and levies, reduce corvée, to relax people's strength.

units.zh: 然後可善治也。」
units.en: Only under those conditions could stable good government emerge."
units.literal: Only then can governance be good."

units.zh: 是月，項梁與兄子羽起吳。
units.en: In this month, Xiang Liang and his brother's son Yu rose up in Wu.
units.literal: This month, Xiang Liang and his brother's son Yu rose in Wu.

units.zh: 四月，項梁擊殺景駒、秦嘉，止薛，沛公往見之。
units.en: In the fourth month, Xiang Liang attacked and killed Jing Ju and Qin Jia, then stopped at Xue. Pei Gong went to see him.
units.literal: Fourth month, Xiang Liang attacked and killed Jing Ju, Qin Jia, stopped at Xue, Pei Gong went to see him.

units.zh: 項梁益沛公卒五千人，五大夫將十人。
units.en: Xiang Liang increased Pei Gong's troops by five thousand men and ten generals of the rank of Grand Master.
units.literal: Xiang Liang increased Pei Gong's troops five thousand, Grand Master generals ten people.

units.zh: 項梁盡召別將。
units.en: Xiang Liang summoned all his deputy generals.
units.literal: Xiang Liang completely summoned the separate generals.

units.zh: 六月，沛公如薛，與項梁共立楚懷王孫心為楚懷王。
units.en: In the sixth month, Pei Gong went to Xue and together with Xiang Liang established Chu King Huai's grandson Xin as King Huai of Chu.
units.literal: Sixth month, Pei Gong went to Xue, together with Xiang Liang established Chu King Huai's grandson Xin as Chu King Huai.

units.zh: 沛公與項梁共救田榮，大破章邯東阿。
units.en: Pei Gong and Xiang Liang together went to rescue Tian Rong and greatly defeated Zhang Han at Dong'e.
units.literal: Pei Gong together with Xiang Liang rescued Tian Rong, greatly defeated Zhang Han at Dong'a.

units.zh: 項梁再破秦軍，有驕色。
units.en: Xiang Liang defeated the Qin army again and showed arrogant bearing.
units.literal: Xiang Liang again defeated Qin army, had arrogant appearance.

units.zh: 九月，章邯夜銜枚擊項梁定陶，大破之，殺項梁。
units.en: In the ninth month, Zhang Han bit on wooden sticks and attacked Xiang Liang at Dingtao by night, greatly defeating him and killing Xiang Liang.
units.literal: Ninth month, Zhang Han night held wooden gag attacked Xiang Liang at Dingtao, greatly defeated him, killed Xiang Liang.

units.zh: 沛公、項羽方攻陳留，聞梁死，士卒恐，乃與將軍呂臣引兵而東，徙懷王自盱台都彭城。
units.en: Pei Gong and Xiang Yu were attacking Chenliu when they heard of Liang's death. The soldiers were terrified, so they joined with General Lü Chen and led troops east, moving King Huai from Xutai to Pengcheng as the capital.
units.literal: Pei Gong, Xiang Yu just attacking Chenliu, heard Liang died, soldiers afraid, then together with general Lu Chen led troops east, moved King Huai from Xutai capital to Pengcheng.

units.zh: 章邯已破項梁，以為楚地兵不足憂，乃渡河北擊趙王歇，大破之。
units.en: Zhang Han had already defeated Xiang Liang and thought that the Chu region's troops were not worth worrying about, so he crossed north of the Yellow River to attack King Xie of Zhao, greatly defeating him.
units.literal: Zhang Han having defeated Xiang Liang, thought Chu territory troops not worth worrying about, then crossed north of Yellow River attacked Zhao King Xie, greatly defeated him.

units.zh: 獨羽怨秦破項梁，奮勢，願與沛公西入關。
units.en: Only Xiang Yu resented Qin for defeating Xiang Liang and was eager to go west into the pass with Pei Gong.
units.literal: Only Yu resented Qin for defeating Xiang Liang, exerted his influence, wished to go west into the pass with Pei Gong.

units.zh: 且楚數進取，前陳王、項梁皆敗，不如更遣長者扶義而西，告諭秦父兄。
units.en: Moreover, Chu has repeatedly advanced but the former King Chen and Xiang Liang both failed. It would be better to send an elder who upholds righteousness to go west and inform the fathers and brothers of Qin.
units.literal: Moreover Chu repeatedly advanced and took, previously King Chen, Xiang Liang all defeated, not as good as again send elder who upholds righteousness west, inform and persuade Qin fathers and elder brothers.

units.zh: 卒不許羽，而遣沛公西收陳王、項梁散卒。
units.en: In the end they did not permit Xiang Yu, but sent Pei Gong west to gather the scattered troops of King Chen and Xiang Liang.
units.literal: In the end did not permit Yu, instead sent Pei Gong west to gather King Chen, Xiang Liang's scattered troops.

units.zh: 初，項梁立韓後公子成為韓王，張良為韓司徒。
units.en: Initially, Xiang Liang established the Han royal descendant Cheng as King of Han, with Zhang Liang as Han tutor.
units.literal: Initially, Xiang Liang established the Han royal descendant Cheng as King of Han, with Zhang Liang as Han tutor.

units.zh: 宋義諫，不聽。
units.en: Song Yi advised against it, but Xiang Liang did not listen.
units.literal: Song Yi advised, did not listen.

units.zh: 使陸賈即授璽綬。
units.en: He sent Lu Jia to personally confer the seal and tassels.
units.literal: He sent Lu Jia to personally confer the seal and tassels.

units.zh: 天下既定，命蕭何次律令，韓信申軍法，張蒼定章程，叔孫通制禮儀，陸賈造新語。
units.en: After the world was settled, he commanded Xiao He to arrange the statutes and commands, Han Xin to explain military law, Zhang Cang to establish procedures, Shusun Tong to create rituals and ceremonies, Lu Jia to compose new discourses.
units.literal: After the world was settled, he commanded Xiao He to arrange the statutes and commands, Han Xin to explain military law, Zhang Cang to establish procedures, Shu Sun Tong to create rituals and ceremonies, Lu Jia to compose new discourses.

units.zh: 杜欽說大將軍王鳳，以為「前河決，丞相史楊焉言延世受焉術以塞之，蔽不肯見。
units.en: Du Qin advised Grand General Wang Feng: "During the previous breach, Chancellor's Clerk Yang Yan said that Yanshi had used a technique learned from him to close it, but Yanshi suppressed his claim and refused to see him.
units.literal: Du Qin advised Grand General Wang Feng: "During the previous breach, Chancellor's Clerk Yang Yan said that Yanshi had used a technique learned from him to close it, but Yanshi suppressed his claim and refused to see him.

units.zh: 鳳如欽言，白遣焉等作治，六月乃成。
units.en: Wang Feng accepted Du Qin's advice, petitioned accordingly, and dispatched Yang Yan and the others. The work was completed by the sixth month.
units.literal: Feng followed Du Qin's words, memorialized and sent Yan and others to work and repair; in sixth month it was completed.

units.zh: 昕曰：「箕子為之奴，何言無也？」
units.en: Xin said, "Jizi became a slave—how say there were none?"
units.literal: Xin said: "Jizi became a slave—how say there were none?"

units.zh: 夫莊周之釣魚兮，辭卿相之顯位；
units.en: Zhuang Zhou angled by the river and refused the highest offices;
units.literal: Now Zhuang Zhou's fishing—ah, declining minister and chancellor's eminent posts;

units.zh: 昔王陵附漢，母在不歸；
units.en: Long ago Wang Ling sided with Han while his mother was alive in Chu and would not return;
units.literal: Long ago Wang Ling sided with Han while his mother lived and did not return;

units.zh: 漢之得人，於茲為盛，儒雅則公孫弘、董仲舒、兒寬，篤行則石建、石慶，質直則汲黯、卜式，推賢則韓安國、鄭當時，定令則趙禹、張湯，文章則司馬遷、相如，滑稽則東方朔、枚皋，應對則嚴助、硃買臣，歷數則唐都、洛下閎，協律則李延年，運籌則桑弘羊，奉使則張騫、蘇武，將率則衛青、霍去病，受遺則霍光、金日磾，其餘不可勝紀。
units.en: Never did the dynasty gather talent so thickly: Hong, Dong, and Kuan for classical breadth; the Shi brothers for steadfast service; Ji An and Bu Shi for blunt loyalty; Han Anguo and Zheng Dangshi for lifting others; Zhao Yu and Zhang Tang for codifying law; Sima Qian and Xiangru for voice; jesters Dongfang Shuo and Mei Gao; debaters Yan Zhu and Zhu Maichen; calendar-makers Tang Du and Luoxia Hong; the harmonist Li Yan'nian; the reckoner Sang Hongyang; envoys Zhang Qian and Su Wu; blades Wei Qing and Huo Qubing; regents Huo Guang and Jin Midi—and a cloud of names besides.
units.literal: Thus Han obtained men; at this time it was most flourishing: in Confucian elegance then Gongsun Hong, Dong Zhongshu, Er Kuan; in steadfast conduct then Shi Jian, Shi Qing; in plain straightforwardness then Ji An, Bu Shi; in advancing the worthy then Han Anguo, Zheng Dangshi; in fixing statutes then Zhao Yu, Zhang Tang; in literary composition then Sima Qian, Xiangru; in jest then Dongfang Shuo, Mei Gao; in repartee then Yan Zhu, Zhu Maichen; in calendrical reckoning then Tang Du, Luoxia Hong; in harmonizing pitch then Li Yan'nian; in planning transport then Sang Hongyang; as envoys then Zhang Qian, Su Wu; as generals then Wei Qing, Huo Qubing; as testamentary appointees then Huo Guang, Jin Midi—the rest cannot be fully recorded.

units.zh: 是時，漢興六十餘載，海內艾安，府庫充實，而四夷未賓，制度多闕。
units.en: By then Han had stood sixty years at peace, the vaults were full, but the border tribes still stood outside the rites and many statutes waited to be written.
units.literal: At that time, more than sixty years after Han's rise, within the seas were at peace, granaries and treasuries were full, yet the four barbarians had not submitted and institutions were still largely lacking.

units.zh: 沛公西過高陽，酈食其為里監門，曰：「諸將過此者多，吾視沛公大度。」
units.en: Pei Gong passed west through Gaoyang. Li Yiji was the village gatekeeper and said: "Many generals have passed through here. I can see that Pei Gong has great magnanimity."
units.literal: Pei Gong west passed Gaoyang, Li Yiji was village gatekeeper, said: 'Various generals who passed this place many, I observe Pei Gong has great magnanimity.'

units.zh: 食其說沛公襲陳留。
units.en: Yiji persuaded Pei Gong to attack Chenliu by surprise.
units.literal: Yiji persuaded Pei Gong to attack Chenliu by surprise.

units.zh: 酈生不拜，長揖曰：「足下必欲誅無道秦，不宜踞見長者。」
units.en: Li Sheng did not bow but gave a deep bow and said: "If you truly wish to execute the tyrannical Qin, you should not sit cross-legged when receiving elders."
units.literal: Li Sheng did not bow, gave long bow said: 'Your excellency certainly wishes to execute unrighteous Qin, should not lounge to see elders.'

units.zh: 沛公以為廣野君，以其弟商為將，將陳留兵。
units.en: Pei Gong made him Lord Guangye and appointed his younger brother Shang as general, commanding the Chenliu troops.
units.literal: Pei Gong made him Lord Guangye and appointed his younger brother Shang as general, commanding the Chenliu troops.

units.zh: 願先遣人益張旗幟於山上為疑兵，使酈食其、陸賈往說秦將，啗以利。」
units.en: I would first send men to set up more banners on the mountains as decoy troops, while Li Yiji and Lu Jia go to persuade the Qin generals and entice them with advantage."
units.literal: I wish to first send people to increase banners on the mountains as feigned troops, and have Li Yiji and Lu Jia go persuade the Qin generals, enticing them with benefits."

units.zh: 秋八月，漢王如滎陽，謂酈食其曰：「緩頰往說魏王豹，能下之，以魏地萬戶封生。」
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn, the King of Han went to Xingyang and said to Li Yiji: "Go and talk Wei Bao into submission with your eloquence. If you can bring him down, I will enfeoff you with ten thousand households from Wei territory."
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, King Han went to Xingyang and said to Li Yiji: "Go slowly to persuade King Wei Bao. If you can make him submit, I will enfeoff you with 10,000 households from Wei territory."

units.zh: 食其往，豹不聽。
units.en: Li Yiji went, but Bao did not listen.
units.literal: Li Yiji went, but Bao did not listen.

units.zh: 食其還，漢王問：「魏大將誰也？」
units.en: Li Yiji returned. King Han asked: "Who is Wei's chief general?"
units.literal: Li Yiji returned. King Han asked: "Who is Wei's chief general?"

units.zh: 曰：「馮敬。」
units.en: Li Yiji replied: "Feng Jing."
units.literal: He said: "Feng Jing."

units.zh: 項羽數侵奪漢甬道，漢軍乏食，與酈食其謀橈楚權。
units.en: Xiang Yu repeatedly invaded and seized Han's covered walkway. The Han army lacked food. He consulted with Li Yiji about weakening Chu's power.
units.literal: Xiang Yu repeatedly invaded and seized Han's covered walkway. The Han army lacked food. He consulted with Li Yiji about weakening Chu's power.

units.zh: 食其欲立六國後以樹黨，漢王刻印，將遣食其立之。
units.en: Li Yiji wanted to establish descendants of the six kingdoms in order to build a bloc of allies. The King of Han had seals carved and was about to send Li Yiji to install them.
units.literal: Li Yiji wished to establish the descendants of the six kingdoms to create allies. King Han carved seals and was about to send Li Yiji to establish them.

units.zh: 漢王使酈食其說齊王田廣，罷守兵與漢和。
units.en: King Han sent Li Yiji to persuade King Qi Tian Guang to dismiss his guarding troops and make peace with Han.
units.literal: King Han sent Li Yiji to persuade King Qi Tian Guang to dismiss his guarding troops and make peace with Han.

units.zh: 齊王亨酈生，東走高密。
units.en: King Qi had Li Yiji boiled alive and fled east to Gaomi.
units.literal: King Qi boiled Li Sheng and fled east to Gaomi.

units.zh: 漢王輟飯吐哺，曰：「豎儒幾敗乃公事！」
units.en: The King of Han put down his food and spat it out, saying: "You pedant! You nearly ruined my whole plan!"
units.literal: King Han put down his food and spat it out, saying: "This pedantic scholar almost ruined your lord's affairs!"
